title: ‘They don’t believe in freedom’: Yemenis plan their escape as Houthis advance on Aden
summary_full: With Iran’s proxy fighters encircling the temporary capital, residents and NGOs prepare to evacuateHussein fled his home six years ago after it fell under Houthi control, moving as far south as he could to the port city of Aden, where there was a measure of safety.The Saudi-backed Yemeni government had made the city its temporary capital; the hundreds of kilometres between it and the Houthis were well fortified.
